title: machines
author: irpina
description: Machines for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys: sounds that play a machine mod's voice in place of FM, through the Digitone's own filter, mixer and effects, with the AMP page's envelope. MACHINES in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) picks the held track's machine; a machine track's SYN1 and SYN2 knobs are the machine's parameters, relabelled. On its own it adds the menu and nothing else: machines come in mods of their own. Needs core-dn1 3.1.
